parameters.name: PreprocessType
parameters.description: The preprocessing type. Set the value to **LivePreprocess**. LivePreprocess specifies that the video is preprocessed in the production studio.

parameters.name: VideoId
parameters.description:
The ID of the video. You can use one of the following methods to obtain the ID:

*   After you upload a video in the ApsaraVideo VOD console, you can log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the ID of the video.
*   Obtain the VideoId from the response to the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation that you call to upload videos.
*   Obtain the VideoId from the response to the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation that you call to query videos.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod submit-preprocess-jobs --video-id d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --preprocess-type LivePreprocess --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod SubmitPreprocessJobs --region cn-hangzhou --VideoId d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --PreprocessType LivePreprocess
